audit.whatIsWrong: diff says HARD but diffRating is 4/10 and both breakdown.difficulty and report[14] read 'Favoured matchup'. Win rate is 41.18%.
audit.why: Three fields describing the same thing disagree; the favourable reading is the one contradicted by the win rate and by the matchup's own late-game prose.
audit.corrected: diffRating 7/10, carryRating 9/10 (Kayle is a hard scaler), and both 'Favoured matchup' strings rewritten to 'Hard matchup'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart is wrong in both layers at four positions: levels 2 and 3 are given to Kayle and levels 4-5 and 6 are given to 'Skill', while the packet chart and the matchup's own whys say the opposite.
audit.why: whys[1] and whys[2] describe Graves shoving a short-ranged Kayle off the wave at 2-3; whys[3] says the stage 'already belongs to Kayle's safety'. The packet chart reads Skill / Graves / Graves / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle.
audit.corrected: Both charts flipped as one atomic group to match the packet and the prose, with Divine Judgment's 160/120/80 cooldown and Kayle's level-11 ranged spike written into the phase text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen is called a blind in eight places — it reduces sight range and slows on impact, it does not make attacks miss. Graves' Q is described as having a 'wall-bounce return'; it detonates after 1 second or on terrain contact, there is no return. And the single most important interaction in the matchup was never stated: Radiant Blast reduces resistances, which directly cancels the True Grit armour Graves builds by dashing at her.
audit.why: Riot's text is the authority on all three. A reader was told to hold trades for a blind that never applies, and to rely on grit armour against the one champion in the matchup who shreds it.
audit.corrected: Blind claims replaced with the sight-range cut and impact slow; the Q corrected to terrain detonation; Radiant Blast's resistance shred written into the levels 4-5 phase and the trading advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment is treated as a constant threat with no number.
audit.why: At rank 1 it is a 160-second cooldown — the longest punish window in the lane, and by far the most concrete green light Graves has.

audit.whatIsWrong: Celestial Blessing is a 15-second flat-cooldown heal and nothing in the itemisation mentions Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: A 15s heal on a scaling carry is the reason extended trades stop paying after level 5.
audit.corrected: Not edited — the itemisation string is shared boilerplate and a rewrite would need more than one matchup's worth of change. Recorded here.

edits.before: Full kit: Q's wall-bounce return is your real damage — fight near terrain so both hits connect.
edits.after: Full kit: End of the Line detonates on terrain — fight by walls; Radiant Blast is her only answer.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Divine Judgment (Invuln); your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: Radiant Blast shreds resistances, so True Grit's armor stops paying — short trades only, and stop forcing once Divine Judgment is up.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 — bait it with Q and an auto, then commit Collateral Damage for the kill.

edits.before: First item spike — the point-blank Q-AA-E-AA pattern now removes half bars. Force fights near walls.
edits.after: Her first item lands with yours and out-scales it — take plates now, force objectives, stop duelling.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: Ranged Kayle kites your reload from max range — play for picks with smoke slows and R snipes, never duels.

edits.after: Your W smoke cuts sight range and slows on impact — drop it on the gank's arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.

edits.before: Play assassin-marksman: smoke their engage, E through fights for armor, and save R as either the execute or the peel knockback. Crit carries out-DPS you — picks don't care.
edits.after: Play assassin-marksman: smoke their engage for the slow and sight cut, E through fights for armor, and save R as the execute. Kayle out-ranges you — picks don't care.

edits.before: Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts her sight and slows on impact — walk in through it so all four pellets land point-blank.

edits.before: With Q, E and W up you dash in, blind the auto she needs to farm, and burst her at point-blank; she has no escape and no item answer yet.
edits.after: With Q, E and W up you dash in, slow her off the wave she needs to farm, and burst her at point-blank; she has no escape and no item answer yet.

edits.before: Your Collateral Damage nuke threatens a solo kill but her R can negate it on reaction, and from Lvl 6 on her power only climbs — the kill window narrows and tilts to her, so this stage already belongs to Kayle's safety.
edits.after: Radiant Blast shreds the resistances True Grit stacks and Celestial Blessing heals every 15s, so extended trades stop paying — this stage already belongs to Kayle's safety, and her power only climbs from here.

edits.before: She hits Lvl 11 true ranged form, out-ranging your shells while your W blind can't touch her ability-based waveclear — your short range is now the liability.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is a 160-second cooldown at rank 1 — bait it with Q and an auto and the kill is there, but commit into it and you spend the magazine on nothing.

edits.before: Ranged-form Kayle kites your reload windows and her invulnerability survives your all-ins; from here she dictates the trades and you cannot answer her range.
edits.after: Ranged-form Kayle kites your two-round reload and her invulnerability survives your all-ins; from here she dictates the trades and you cannot answer her range.

edits.before: Get Q then E and you out-stat her instantly — short-ranged Kayle can't trade into your point-blank shell spread, and your W blind blanks the autos she needs to last-hit, so shove her under tower and starve her CS/XP.
edits.after: Get Q then E and you out-stat her instantly — short-ranged Kayle can't trade into your point-blank spread, and Smoke Screen's slow and sight cut drag her off the minions she needs to last-hit, so shove her under tower and starve her CS and XP.

edits.before: Kayle's first true ranged form (permanent ranged autos) — she now out-ranges your shells and your W blind can't stop her once she peels back; your short range becomes the liability and the lane flips for good.
edits.after: Kayle's first true ranged form (permanent ranged autos) — she now out-ranges your shells, and Smoke Screen only cuts sight, so it cannot stop an ability-driven clear; your short range becomes the liability and the lane flips for good.

edits.before: Use stacked E charges to weave into point-blank range and W-blind the auto she's trying to last-hit with before she can answer
edits.after: Use stacked E charges to weave into point-blank range and Smoke-Screen the minion she's trying to last-hit before she can answer

edits.before: Kayle is at her weakest here and your entire win condition is punishing it — she's a short-ranged scaling carry with no escape and no answer to your burst before she gets items. Use E to dash into point-blank range, dump your 4-shell spread, and drop W on top of her so the smoke blinds the auto she's reaching for and starves her of last-hits. Don't settle for poke; shove the wave into her tower so she has to walk into your shells to farm. Every level and every minion she misses now delays the only thing that makes Kayle scary — her items and levels — so play to deny, not just to trade.
edits.after: Kayle is at her weakest here and your entire win condition is punishing it — she's a short-ranged scaling carry with no escape and no answer to your burst before she gets items. Use E to dash into point-blank range, dump your 4-shell spread past the wave since your bullets don't pass through units, and drop W on her for the impact slow and the sight cut so she loses the last-hit. Don't settle for poke; shove into her tower so she has to walk into your shells to farm. Every minion she misses delays the only thing that makes Kayle scary — so play to deny, not just to trade.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your True Grit armor/MR stacking and second E charge make extended melee trades one-sided — she can't out-DPS you up close before she gets range. At 6 your Collateral Damage can one-shot a squishy Kayle, but respect her R: if she pops the invulnerability through your nuke she negates all of it and walks away, so bait the ult with Q and an auto first, then commit the kill. This is your last clean kill window. Once she hits 11 and gains permanent ranged autos, your short range turns into a liability and the lane swings hard to her.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 look like your window, but Radiant Blast reduces resistances on everything it hits — the True Grit armour you stack by dashing at her is exactly what her Q takes back, and Celestial Blessing heals her every 15 seconds, so extended trades stop paying. At 6 your Collateral Damage can one-shot a squishy Kayle, but Divine Judgment is 160 seconds at rank 1: bait it with Q and an auto, then commit. That is your last clean kill window. At 11 she gains permanent ranged autos and the lane swings hard to her.

edits.before: This is where you lose if the game gets here. Ranged-form Kayle out-ranges your entire shell kit, her on-hit waveclear ignores your W blind because blind only stops her autos' physical hits and her clear is ability-driven, and her R makes her unkillable through any all-in you set up. Your reload windows become death sentences when she kites you from max range. Do not try to 1v1 a fed Kayle — your job was to end the game in the first 15 minutes, and if you couldn't, stop forcing the lane: group, take objectives, and skirmish elsewhere as a mobile carry while your team peels her invuln window.
edits.after: This is where you lose if the game gets here. Ranged-form Kayle out-ranges your entire shell kit, her clear is ability-driven so Smoke Screen's sight cut does nothing to it, Radiant Blast shreds the resistances your E stacks, and her R makes her unkillable through any all-in you set up. Your two-round reload becomes a death sentence when she kites from max range. Do not 1v1 a fed Kayle — your job was to end it inside 15 minutes, and if you couldn't, stop forcing the lane: group, take objectives, and skirmish elsewhere while your team waits out her 80-second invulnerability.

notes: The ownerKit derived flag on Graves' Q reads 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes', which contradicts Riot's own description ('detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain'). End of the Line does not create terrain. I trusted the description and wrote nothing that depends on the flag. Third: packet.suspectNames flags 'Your Collateral Damage' as a probable wrong name — false positive, Collateral Damage is Graves' real R.
